content.about: Costa Rica is a Central American country with rainforests, volcanoes and two coasts. A quarter of its land is protected. It abolished its army in 1948. Sloths and toucans live in its forests.

standout.text: Costa Rica has about 5% of the world's species in only 0.03% of its land.

didYouKnow: It runs on mostly renewable electricity.
